## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** No KB-BIJECTION RED for task 0's policies, their base policies, parameters or tool contracts. First revision; no previous revision.

Policy-side notes (do not change this verdict):
- The closing-settlement rule's overwrites retire two general periodic clauses (net-remit retention of fees each period; periodic offset of past-due invoices against gross remittance), while the replacing text speaks only of the closing settlement. The KB faithfully writes both as retired, so for ordinary periods the corpus now has no in-force clause for net-remit fee retention, while fee_invoicing §1.3 and reversals_and_fee_credits still speak of "retained fees" of a net-remittance agreement (as the source does). This is an overwrite-scope question on the policy side.
- The parameter meaning of `fees_offset_against_remittance` ("whether past-due fees may be deducted from the next gross remittance") is phrased in terms of the retired clause; the KB carries it verbatim (invoicing_and_late_charge_terms). Source-faithful.
- The pre-collect reduction counts unit-history entries of type `flatfee_conversion_requested` as "debtors converted"; the KB follows the source's wording.
